description: Ministry of Public Administration Home Affairs & Justice - Trust Ordinance (Chapter 87)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Trusts Ordinance, establishing legal requirements for record-keeping, registration, and information maintenance related to express trusts. It creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for trustees and registrars, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
